theme_central: The night star piercing the darkness, just as the Qur'an is a decisive word piercing falsehood — Allah Himself will counter the disbelievers' scheming.

branches.title: Oath, the night star
branches.resume: Oath by the sky and the piercing star; no soul without a keeper watching over it.

children.t: Oath by the night star, a keeper watching over every soul

branches.title: Man's creation, ability to resurrect him
branches.resume: Man created from a gushing fluid; Allah able to bring him back to life, a day when secrets are disclosed.

children.t: Creation from a gushing fluid, divine ability to resurrect

branches.title: Decisive word, divine counter-scheme
branches.resume: The Qur'an, a decisive word and not a jest; to the disbelievers' scheming, Allah answers with His own counter-scheme.

children.t: The Qur'an, a decisive word; divine counter-scheme to the disbelievers' plotting
